submissionAttempts.body:
The host-contract version that applies to this workspace's integration is **1**.

Determination (by the repo's own PLMP-ALN-2 source-precedence rule, docs/engineering/08-source-precedence-policy.md):

1. **Tier 1 — published contract of the exact pinned version (governs).** This workspace pins the Ordarium release tarballs at **ordarium-v1.3.1** in both package.json (deps: @ordarium/core, @ordarium/host-kit, @ordarium/ledger-sqlite, devDep @ordarium/testing) and pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides — the four-line pin policy from 07 r8, and the installed node_modules artifacts are @ordarium/core 1.3.1 / @ordarium/host-kit 1.3.1. The shipped declaration in the pinned artifact, node_modules/@ordarium/core/dist/src/host.js, states `export const HOST_CONTRACT_VERSION = 1;`, and @ordarium/host-kit re-exports it from core (dist/src/index.d.ts). `assertHostContract(version)` throws HostContractMismatchError on any inexact match. So the pinned dependency's host-facing contract generation is 1.

2. **Tier 2 — project normative spec (consistent).** docs/engineering/13-host-adapter-conformance-spec.md (PLMP-CONF-1, status "已交付") specifies the assembly-time handshake `assertHostContract(1)` as the literal pin, and the implementation matches: src/effects/runtime.ts:128 calls `assertHostContract(1)` with a comment that a contract bump fails closed at assembly. Test test/host_conformance.test.ts CONF-A01 asserts `assertHostContract(1)` passes and `assertHostContract(2)` throws. 07-ordarium-alignment.md §2 item 4/#9 records the same consumption at generation 1.

3. **Tier 3 — informational record (does not control).** docs/engineering/notes/host-contract-note.md says an "early integration note recorded the host contract version as **2**", but it self-declares "Status: informational, not normative." Under ALN-2 rule 3, informational records never override tiers 1–2. It is also factually unsupported: no pinned artifact, spec, test, or alignment entry contains generation 2, and 07 r19 explicitly records "无 HOST_CONTRACT_VERSION→2 计划".

Conclusion: the co-applicable load-bearing sources (pinned artifact + normative spec + executable handshake/test) all agree on generation 1; the lone "2" is a non-normative early note that the precedence policy subordinates. Applicable host-contract version = 1. No genuine cross-repo conflict remains, so no peer escalation was required.
